why_best: This approach maintains high narrative velocity while establishing a direct visual link between the call-to-action and its eventual outcome.
why_bad: A slow cross-dissolve or spatial wipe would muddy the visual hierarchy and feel sluggish for a high-impact marketing reveal.
trap: Failing to align the incoming focal shape's size and center point precisely at the instant of the scene swap will cause a jarring jump that destroys the illusion.
